build_sst_dataset: build the SST dataset by downloading train, dev, and test binary sentiment CSV files
download_sst_resources: download the SST binary sentiment CSV files from the OpenAI generating reviews repository
check_sst_data_built: check if the SST dataset has already been built in the specified datapath directory
remove_outdated_sst_data: remove outdated SST dataset files when an older version exists in the datapath
mark_sst_data_done: mark the SST dataset as built and complete in the build data directory
